title: A Comparison for Anti-noise Robustness of Deep Learning Classification Methods on a Tiny Object Image Dataset: from Convolutional Neural Network to Visual Transformer and Performer
reasoning: The paper is a technical, empirical study comparing the performance and anti-noise robustness of various computer vision models (CNNs, Visual Transformers) on a tiny object image dataset. It does not contain any content related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
